cohort: 4,428 women with twin pregnancies (341 with GDM, 4,087 without GDM) who delivered at a tertiary medical center between 1988 and 2010
finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus in twin pregnancies was not associated with increased rates of adverse perinatal outcomes or cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: While twin pregnancies complicated with gestational diabetes had higher rates of cesarean deliveries overall, after adjusting for confounders gestational diabetes was not an independent risk factor for cesarean delivery in twin pregnancies.
